title: Users remain uncertain about how a garment will fit despite having some size information, and some seek extra measurements, photos, or reviews before buying.
description: Users describing comparison, post-purchase repeatedly surface fit, comparison, quality uncertainty, price. Some still complete a purchase; others postpone, abandon, or keep considering. This is an observed pattern in public comments, not a proven cause of 30-day wishlist conversion.
research_gap: We do not yet know whether 'fit, comparison, quality uncertainty, price' actually causes 30-day wishlist non-conversion, for whom it is most severe, or whether it occurs before vs after saving an item.
why_ranked_higher: Ranked #1 vs #2 because composite score is 3.5 points higher. Largest weighted driver on this opportunity: workaround intensity (100.0/100, weight 12%).
scoring_notes: Composite score is a weighted sum of 10 documented dimensions (see scores). Purchase association is co-occurrence with postponement/abandonment/alternative/still-considering language, not causation. Monetary incentives are out of scope for solutions even if price appears as a barrier.
